Prerequisites: Citizen must be logged in. Departments & wards must be configured.

1. User clicks 'Report Issue' on homepage hero.
2. If logged in -> opens /complaint.
3. If guest -> redirects to /auth with redirect query param.
4. After authentication -> immediately resumes at Complaint Form.

Prerequisites: GPS permission enabled in browser/mobile; logged-in citizen session.
User Action Flow (Step-by-Step):
1. Citizen selects civic department (Water, Roads, Sanitation, etc.).
2. Citizen types issue description (min 10 chars).
3. Name & phone auto-prefill from auth profile.
4. Citizen clicks 'Detect My Location' (GPS reverse-geocoding) or enters address manually.
5. Citizen captures/uploads issue photo.
6. Photo is stamped with GPS watermark.
7. Submits complaint.
8. Unique ticket number (IMC-YYYY-XXXXX) generated.
Backend / Database Operations: Inserts into complaints table with department_id, latitude, longitude, address, photo_url, citizen_phone, and created_by=user.id.
Audit Verdict & Technical Notes: 100% Complete. Auto-prefill active, stores ticket in local storage cache (betul_my_complaints), and attaches created_by.

User Action Flow (Step-by-Step):
1. User visits /track.
2. Enters ticket number (e.g. IMC-2026-00020).
3. Clicks 'Track'.
4. Interactive 4-stage timeline renders: Pending -> In Progress -> Resolved -> Verified & Closed.
5. Displays department name, filed date, SLA timers, officer resolution remarks, and proof photos.
6. If rejected, shows rejection reason clearly.
Backend / Database Operations: Selects from complaints table with join on departments, resolutions, and verifications tables.
Audit Verdict & Technical Notes: 100% Complete. Includes visual status stepper, resolution evidence photos, and officer remarks.

Prerequisites: Complaint marked as 'resolved' by department staff.
User Action Flow (Step-by-Step):
1. Citizen inspects resolved ticket on /track.
2. Inspects resolution remarks & proof photo.
3. If Satisfied: Clicks 'Verify & Close' -> status becomes verified -> closed timestamp logged.
4. If NOT Satisfied: Clicks 'Not Resolved / Reassign' -> modal opens -> enters dissatisfaction reason -> escalates to Verifier.
Backend / Database Operations: Inserts verification record into verifications table and updates complaints.status to 'verified' or 'escalated'.
Audit Verdict & Technical Notes: 100% Complete. True closed-loop governance: staff cannot close their own ticket without citizen or verifier sign-off.

Feature Name / Requirement: Local News & Community Feed Post Submission
User Action Flow (Step-by-Step):
1. Citizen clicks 'Submit a Post' in News section.
2. Selects category: News / Alert / Event / Thought.
3. Enters headline, description, and optional photo.
4. Clicks Submit.
5. Post enters admin moderation queue (pending status).
6. Not visible publicly until admin approval.
Backend / Database Operations: Inserts into local_news table with status='pending', author_id=user.id, author_name=profile.full_name.
Audit Verdict & Technical Notes: 100% Complete. Post creation modal with image uploader, tag selection, and moderation queue filtering.

User Action Flow (Step-by-Step):
1. Citizen navigates to /profile.
2. Views profile details (name, phone, ward number).
3. Views social metrics (followers, thoughts posted).
4. Switches to 'Complaints' tab.
5. Views list of all personal complaints filed with live status badges.
Backend / Database Operations: Multi-clause query matching created_by.eq.user.id OR citizen_phone.eq.userPhone OR ticket in localStorage cache.
Audit Verdict & Technical Notes: 100% Complete. Fixed past complaints visibility bug; shows both historical and newly submitted tickets reliably.

Prerequisites: Staff account registered and approved by Admin.

2. Enters staff code / email and password.
3. Database verifies approval_status=='approved' and active role.
4. Loads officer's department and hierarchy tier.

Feature Name / Requirement: Department Dashboard (D01 Overview, D02 Queue, D03 Workspace)
User Action Flow (Step-by-Step):
1. D01 (Overview): Displays summary cards for New, Unassigned, In-Progress, Overdue, and Resolved tickets.
2. D02 (Queue): Lists open tickets with priority badges, ward filters, and SLA deadlines.
3. D03 (Workspace): Full single-complaint inspection panel with citizen notes, original photo, GPS pin, and action buttons.
Backend / Database Operations: Queries complaints filtered by department_id with joined user_profiles and resolutions.
Audit Verdict & Technical Notes: 100% Complete. High-density responsive operational workspace tailored for municipal desk officers.

Feature Name / Requirement: Hierarchical Complaint Allotment to Field Staff
Prerequisites: Supervisor or Dept Head tier (Tier 4+); staff registered in department.
User Action Flow (Step-by-Step):
1. Supervisor opens unassigned ticket in D03.
2. Clicks 'Allot' button.
3. Modal lists eligible subordinate workers in department hierarchy.
4. Selects field worker.
5. Sets optional task instructions and SLA deadline.
6. Clicks 'Assign Work'.
7. Worker receives task; ticket status updates to 'in_progress'.
Backend / Database Operations: Updates complaints.assigned_to, assigned_by, status='in_progress', and logs allotment timestamp.
Audit Verdict & Technical Notes: 100% Complete. Enforces organizational tiering: field workers (Tier 5) are restricted from delegating tasks.

User Action Flow (Step-by-Step):
1. Supervisor opens already-assigned ticket in D03.
2. Clicks 'Reassign'.
3. Selects new employee from hierarchy.
4. Enters mandatory reason for transfer.
5. Confirms action.
6. Previous assignee loses access; new worker gets ticket in queue.
Backend / Database Operations: Updates complaints.assigned_to and appends reassignment note to complaint audit history.
Audit Verdict & Technical Notes: 100% Complete. Validates mandatory transfer remarks before committing update.

Feature Name / Requirement: Bulk Task Allocation by Ward / Department
User Action Flow (Step-by-Step):
1. Supervisor opens Bulk Allocation panel.
2. Filters complaints by ward or category.
3. Checks multi-select checkboxes for multiple tickets.
4. Selects target field worker from dropdown.
5. Clicks 'Allocate All'.
6. All selected tickets are batch-assigned.
Backend / Database Operations: Batch update transaction on complaints table assigning multiple IDs to selected user_id.
Audit Verdict & Technical Notes: 100% Complete. Tested with 10+ tickets simultaneously; eliminates repetitive single-ticket clicking.

Feature Name / Requirement: GPS Radar Scanner & Nearby Proximity Search
User Action Flow (Step-by-Step):
1. Officer opens Radar Scanner.
2. Selects ward or GPS point.
3. Selects search radius (500m to 5km).
4. Haversine algorithm scans all complaints in database.
5. Renders nearby tickets list and distance in meters.
6. Officer batch-allots nearby tickets to single field worker.
Backend / Database Operations: PostGIS / client Haversine distance computation: haversineMeters(centerLat, centerLng, compLat, compLng).
Audit Verdict & Technical Notes: 100% Complete. Enables cluster-based field routing, drastically cutting fuel and travel time for municipal vans.

User Action Flow (Step-by-Step):

2. Opens ticket in workspace.
3. Clicks 'Resolve'.
4. Enters resolution remarks (work description).
5. Uploads live completion photo.
6. Canvas engine stamps GPS coords, address, timestamp, and logo onto image.
7. Submits resolution.
8. Status changes to 'resolved'.
Backend / Database Operations: Uploads watermarked photo to complaint-photos bucket; inserts record into resolutions table; updates complaint status.
Audit Verdict & Technical Notes: 100% Complete. Optimized image pipeline (1200px / 0.80 quality) with real-time byte progress.

Feature Name / Requirement: Control Room Live Map & Misrouted Ticket Rerouting

1. Operator opens /control-room.
2. Inspects live map showing color-coded pins of city issues.
3. Identifies misclassified complaint.
4. Clicks 'Reroute'.
5. Selects correct civic department.
6. Adjusts urgency priority (H0 Critical to H3 Routine).
7. Ticket transfers instantly to new department queue.
Backend / Database Operations: Updates complaints.department_id, priority, and logs routing transfer in database.
Audit Verdict & Technical Notes: 100% Complete. Supports real-time grievance triage and emergency escalation for civic disasters.

Prerequisites: Assigned verifier role; complaint disputed by citizen.
User Action Flow (Step-by-Step):
1. Verifier opens /verifier.
2. Reviews escalated dispute case.
3. Examines original photo, resolution photo, officer remarks, and citizen complaint history.
4. Decision A: If work is valid -> clicks 'Verify & Close' (closes ticket).

Backend / Database Operations: Updates verifications table and transitions complaints.status to 'verified' or 'in_progress'.
